```sql
SELECT c.id,
       c.email,
       c.company,
       c.country_code,
       t.revenue,
       t.order_count,
       t.last_order_at
  FROM customers c
  JOIN (
        SELECT o.customer_id,
               sum(o.total_cents) AS revenue,
               count(*)           AS order_count,
               max(o.created_at)  AS last_order_at
          FROM orders o
          JOIN customers ci ON ci.id = o.customer_id
                           AND ci.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s
         WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'processing', 'shipped', 'delivered')
         GROUP BY o.customer_id
        HAVING max(o.created_at) >= %(from)s
           AND max(o.created_at) <  %(to)s
       ) t ON t.customer_id = c.id
 WHERE c.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s
 ORDER BY t.revenue DESC
 LIMIT %(limit)s
```

De gematerialiseerde CTE werd twee keer gescand. De join met de aggregaat liep zonder hash-join als nested loop over ongeveer 48 miljoen rijen. Nu berekent één enkele GROUP BY tegelijk de som, het aantal en `max(created_at)`, wat precies de waarde is die `DISTINCT ON … ORDER BY created_at DESC` opleverde; vooraf wordt alleen op klanten van de tenant gefilterd en het venster wordt in de HAVING toegepast.
